listRow: u32 reference, up to18 safe encoded characters, ff delimiter, zero padding to19 label bytes
homeBody: u32 actual incoming follower count; header final u16 is eligible post count
postBody: 1..71 safe encoded bytes; only fe newline, no ff/fc/fd placeholders or controls
selection: snapshot-local references map to immutable durable postIDs; references are not permissions
close: native cancellation clears mailbox before freeing screen; host has one bounded owner snapshot; idle expiry600s, successful scoped query renews; explicit close operation also supported
refresh: explicit home Refresh issues a new open request and discards old snapshot
scope: trusted host campaign,branch,social restore epoch,player; visibility/participation rechecked per query
history: no read markers, model calls, NPC exposure, publication or follow changes
